status: prospectively specified before checkpoint audit and training
scope: separate experiment; never replace or modify current models, checkpoints, combo, or results
primary_selection_metric: macro EF@20 on unchanged existing P+U query lists
encoder: frozen esm2_150m; original TRAIN-standardized 640-dimensional pooled features
tuna_checkpoint_audit_role: development-only diagnostic; no TUnA retraining or new TUnA test checkpoint selection
initialization: random initialization identical by seed across the two new variants; not fine-tuning a current checkpoint
schedule: 5 percent linear warmup, cosine decay to 10 percent of peak; original iPIN schedule
train_query_sampling: uniform among TRAIN queries with P>=1 and U>=1; sample one P and one U uniformly within the same query
train_query_scale: Nq / mean_Nq; averaging over P samples supplies 1/Pq; approximation aligned to macro EF, not an exact EF loss
train_U_design_weights: not used: target is unweighted existing query lists, not the former population-weighted global objective
shortlist_rule: for every TRAIN query, rank its complete existing P+U list once at each epoch start in eval mode; top-40 U get extra weight up to 2 with fractional tie credit; normalize U weights to mean 1 within query; no U is dropped or relabeled
shortlist_note: bounded top-rank P-versus-U surrogate, not exact EF optimization or unbiased PN risk; may penalize latent positives
ensemble: all three seeds; same epoch; mean of FP32 member scores accumulated in FP64
checkpoint_selection: maximum ensemble C3-development macro EF@20; earliest epoch if tied within 1e-12
primary_variant_selection: max C3-dev EF@20 among checkpoint-selected historical iPIN, query_balanced, shortlist_weighted; tie prefer historical, then query_balanced, then shortlist_weighted
test_ablation_reporting: freeze the three variant checkpoints together before test; report all prespecified ablations but do not reselect the winner on test
query_orientation: both endpoints; same eligibility and lists for every scorer
ranking_ties: fractional expected credit; any-hit probability averaged over random tie order
bootstrap_unit: query sequence component, keeping full fixed query lists and multiplicity
bootstrap_intervals: paired percentile 2.5/97.5; conditional on candidate library, not multiplicity adjusted
